hero.subheadline: Real-time IoT telemetry to optimize equipment usage, reduce wait times, and maximize your clients' satisfaction

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Revolutionize the fitness industry through IoT solutions that allow gyms to operate more efficiently and clients to train without interruptions.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be the leading telemetry platform in Peru for intelligent gym management, setting the standard in equipment monitoring technology.

product.title: Product
product.description: A complete SaaS platform that combines Edge IoT sensors, cloud storage, and predictive analytics to transform the gym experience.

iotSensors.title: Edge IoT Sensors
iotSensors.description: Telemetry hardware installed on every machine to detect usage in real time without manual intervention.

cloudStorage.title: Cloud Storage
cloudStorage.description: Secure and scalable historical data for trend analysis and long-term projections.

realTimeMonitor.title: Real-Time Monitoring
realTimeMonitor.description: Heat map updated every second showing equipment availability for clients and administrators.

maintenanceAlerts.title: Maintenance Alerts
maintenanceAlerts.description: Predictive system that automatically generates tickets when equipment exceeds safe usage hour thresholds.

analyticDashboard.title: Analytics Dashboard
analyticDashboard.description: Management panel with usage charts, stress peaks, underutilized equipment, and ROI calculation.

jwtSecurity.title: JWT Security
jwtSecurity.description: Robust authentication with JWT tokens to protect sensitive client data and operations.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your access to and use of SpotTrack's IoT gym monitoring platform and related services. By using SpotTrack, you agree to be bound by these terms.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using SpotTrack, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions and our data processing practices.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.body: SpotTrack provides IoT sensors, cloud storage, and analytics dashboards that report gym equipment usage and availability in real time. Availability and accuracy of telemetry data depend on the proper installation and functioning of hardware sensors.

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions & Payment
sections.body: Paid plans (Basic, Mid, Platinum) are billed on a recurring monthly basis through our payment processor. Prices, features, and billing cycles may change with prior notice. Failure to pay may result in suspension of access.

sections.heading: 4. User Responsibilities
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity carried out under your account. You agree not to misuse, reverse-engineer, or interfere with the platform's hardware or software.

sections.heading: 5. Data & Privacy
sections.body: Equipment usage data collected by SpotTrack sensors is stored securely and used exclusively to provide analytics and alerts to your gym. We do not sell client telemetry data to third parties.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All software, dashboards, branding, and documentation related to SpotTrack remain the exclusive property of SpotTrack and its licensors.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: SpotTrack is provided on an "as is" basis. We are not liable for indirect damages, equipment downtime, or losses arising from sensor malfunction, connectivity issues, or third-party service outages.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate access to the platform for violation of these terms. You may cancel your subscription at any time; access remains active until the end of the current billing period.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions periodically. Continued use of SpotTrack after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms & Conditions, please reach out through the contact form on this site.
